venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Science, (2019), 116(12), pp.5293-5298
abstract: This study considers the response of household electricity consumption to social nudges during peak load events. Our investigation considers two social nudges. The first targets conservation during peak load events, while the second promotes aggregate conservation. Using data from a natural field experiment with 42,100 households, we find that both social nudges reduce peak load electricity consumption by 2 to 4% when implemented in isolation and by nearly 7% when implemented in combination. These findings suggest an important role for social nudges in the regulation of electricity markets and a limited role for crowd out effects.

venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, (2016), 10(2), 206- 225. "
abstract: Field experiments provide a useful way to address a number of important issues in environmental and resource economics. This article provides a review of studies that have used field experiments to inform (1) benefit–cost analysis and (2) efforts to promote resource conservation. In these areas, scholars have used field experiments to test existing theories, inform the development of new theories, and guide policymakers. After summarizing these contributions, we discuss new directions for the use of field experiments in environmental and resource economics.

abstract: We implement a public goods game and a social intervention modeled after a public goods game in rural Sierra Leone near the Gola Forest Reserve. We also collect demographic, economic and forest conservation data on households in the area. We use this data to assess the mapping of social preferences from the artefactual field experiment (AFE) into real world behavior. We find evidence of heterogeneity in shifting factors between the AFE, the field experiment, and conservation outcomes. We also find evidence that social controls like war violence and witchcraft may explain some of this correlation.

abstract: As we contemplate the state of academic research in the agricultural economics community, there are two facts that are difficult to overlook. First, over roughly the first half of the twentieth century, scholars working on agricultural issues were the toast of the academy, setting forth an empirical research agenda that served to influence social and natural scientists profoundly. The seminal contributions made in these early years continue to shape important academic and policy debates.A second fact remains that this dominance has waned in the past several decades, with major empirical advances now more likely in sister fields, such as labor economics or industrial organization. abstract: Recent empirical work suggests that (i) incomes are converging through time, and (ii) income and pollution levels are linked. This paper weds these two literatures by examining the spatial and temporal distribution of pollution. After establishing that theoretical predictions about whether pollution will converge are critically linked to certain structural parameters, we explore pollution convergence using state‐level data on two important pollutants—nitrogen oxides and sulfur oxides—from 1929 to 1999. We find stronger evidence of converging emission rates during the federal pollution control years (1970–1999) than during the local control years (1929–1969). These results suggest that income convergence alone may not be sufficient to induce convergence of pollutant emissions.
abstract_zh: 近期的实证研究表明：(i) 收入随时间趋于收敛；(ii) 收入水平与污染水平相互关联。本文通过考察污染的空间与时间分布，将这两支文献结合起来。在指出污染是否会趋同的理论预测关键取决于某些结构性参数之后，我们使用1929至1999年间两种重要污染物——氮氧化物和硫氧化物——的州级数据，探讨了污染趋同问题。我们发现，在联邦污染控制时期（1970–1999年），排放率趋同的证据比地方控制时期（1929–1969年）更强。这些结果表明，仅有收入趋同可能不足以促使污染物排放趋同。

title: How Elections Matter: Theory and Evidence from Environmental Policy
abstract: In this paper we explore to what extent secondary policy issues are influenced by electoral incentives. We develop a political agency model in which a politician decides on both a frontline policy issue, such as the level of public spending, and a secondary policy issue, such as environmental policy. The model shows under which conditions the incumbent finds it worthwhile to manipulate the secondary policy to attract additional votes to his platform. We test the predictions of the model using state-level panel data on Gubernatorial environmental policy choices over the years 1960-2000.In contrast to the popular view that choices on secondary policy instruments are largely determined by lobbying, we find strong effects of electoral incentives on environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨次要政策议题在多大程度上受到选举激励的影响。我们构建了一个政治代理模型，其中政治家同时决定一项前线政策议题（如公共支出水平）和一项次要政策议题（如环境政策）。该模型揭示了在何种条件下，现任者会认为操纵次要政策以吸引额外选票是值得的。我们利用1960至2000年各州州长环境政策选择的州级面板数据，检验了模型的预测。与普遍认为次要政策工具的选择主要由游说决定的观点相反，我们发现选举激励对环境政策具有显著影响。

Shadow prices, environmental stringency, and international competitiveness
abstract: Empirical tests of the relationship between international competitiveness and the severity of environmental regulations are hampered by the lack of pollution abatement cost data for non-U.S. countries. The theory of the firm suggests that environmental stringency can be measured by the difference between a polluting input's shadow price and its market price. We make a first attempt at quantifying such a measure for two industries located in nine European OECD countries. Overall, we provide (i) a new approach to measure cross-country regulatory differences in that we use a theoretically attractive measure of industry-specific private compliance cost, and (ii) empirical estimates that are an attractive tool for researchers and policymakers who are interested in examining how economic activity is influenced by compliance costs.
abstract_zh: 由于缺乏非美国国家的污染治理成本数据，关于国际竞争力与环境监管严格程度之间关系的实证检验受到阻碍。企业理论认为，环境监管的严格程度可以通过某一污染性投入品的影子价格与其市场价格之差来衡量。我们首次尝试为位于九个欧洲经合组织（OECD）国家的两个行业量化这一指标。总体而言，我们的贡献在于：(i) 提供了一种衡量跨国监管差异的新方法，即采用理论上更具吸引力的、针对特定行业的私人合规成本指标；以及 (ii) 提供了实证估计结果，这对于研究合规成本如何影响经济活动的研究者和政策制定者而言，是一种有价值的工具。

title: Using Experimental Methods in Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This book explores frontier work at the intersection of experimental and environmental economics, with cutting edge research provided by premier scholars in the field. The book begins by focusing on improving benefit - cost analysis, which remains the hallmark of public policy decision-making around the globe. The contributors provide innovative avenues to credibly lead to more efficient policies. These insights should prove to be fundamental components of the valuation process. They then explore, in a myriad clever ways, important aspects associated with optimal resource use and regulation of resources. Clearly, these issues remain of utmost importance, both in a positive and normative sense, therefore the authors offer a good introduction to some of these issues and present logical solutions. A discussion of behavioural economics and non-market valuation is also provided. Students and policymakers will find Using Experimental Methods in Environmental and Resource Economics of great interest.
abstract_zh: 本书探讨实验经济学与环境经济学交叉领域的前沿工作，并汇集了该领域顶尖学者的前沿研究。本书首先聚焦于改进成本效益分析，这一方法仍是全球公共政策决策的标志性工具。各位撰稿人提出了具有创新性的途径，以可信地实现更有效率的政策。这些洞见应当成为估值过程的基本组成部分。随后，他们以多种巧妙的方式，探讨了与资源最优利用及资源监管相关的重要方面。显然，这些问题无论在实证还是规范意义上都至关重要，因此作者对其中若干问题作了很好的入门介绍，并提出了合乎逻辑的解决方案。书中还讨论了行为经济学与非市场估值。学生和政策制定者都会对《环境与资源经济学中的实验方法》一书大感兴趣。

title: Scientific Numerology, Preference Pnomalies, and Environmental Policymaking
abstract: Recently an abundance of experimental evidence has been gathered that is consonant with the notion that individual preferences are inconsistent and unstable. These empirical results potentially undermine the theoretical foundation of welfare economics, as the degree of preference liability claimed suggests that perhaps no optimization principles underlie even the most straightforward of choices. Yet policymakers in the environmental arena continue to prescribe policies based on economics-based methods that are constructed on the very principles that have been directly refuted. Are policymakers creatures of habit that move at glacial speed or is there something deeper behind their inertness? In this study, I explore this issue within the U.S. context and argue that there is some rationality behind current public policy decision making. I then explore whether the empirical evidence supports the view that policymakers should take preference anomalies seriously. As a case study, I focus on some of my recent findings on preference inconsistencies in the marketplace.
abstract_zh: 近来，大量实验证据表明，个体偏好是不一致且不稳定的。这些实证结果可能动摇福利经济学的理论基础，因为所主张的偏好不稳定程度似乎意味着，即使是最简单的选择，也可能并不建立在任何最优化原则之上。然而，环境领域的政策制定者仍在继续依据经济学方法提出政策建议，而这些方法恰恰建立在已被直接驳斥的原则之上。政策制定者究竟是行动迟缓的习惯性动物，还是其不作为背后另有更深层的原因？在本研究中，我以美国的情境探讨这一问题，并认为当前的公共政策决策在某种程度上具有合理性。随后，我探讨了实证证据是否支持政策制定者应当认真对待偏好异常的观点。作为案例研究，我聚焦于本人近期关于市场中偏好不一致性的一些发现。

abstract: Sustainable development has been a popular buzzword among policymakers and economists for over a decade. Although a key tenet of maintaining a sustainable development path for many economies rests on attracting mobile capital, theoretical and empirical evidence into the institutional policies that attract factors remains largely unresolved. This paper takes a positive look at the determinants of attracting capital with particular attention paid to intellectual property rights and environmental regulations. (JEL F23, O34, Q28)
abstract_zh: 十多年来，可持续发展一直是政策制定者和经济学家中流行的热词。尽管对于许多经济体而言，维持可持续发展路径的一项关键原则在于吸引流动资本，但有关吸引生产要素的制度性政策的理论与实证证据在很大程度上仍未得到解决。本文从实证角度考察吸引资本的决定因素，并特别关注知识产权保护与环境监管。（JEL分类号：F23, O34, Q28）

abstract: Devolution of tasks to local levels of government has recently become a popular agenda item within certain political factions in the US. While one expects the local policymaker to tailor policies to match the preferences of his constituents, critics of local policymaking claim that externalities are ignored and inefficiencies thus arise under local control of certain policies. A primary example concerns the control of pollution, which is known to have adverse effects on neighbouring jurisdictions. Whether localities actually ‘race to the bottom’ and enact lax environmental policies when given the chance remains an open issue. In this study, we make use of stochastic dominance tests to examine if President Reagan's policy of ‘New Federalism’ in the early 1980s induced states to lower environmental standards. Among the several environmental measures analysed, we do not find any evidence that the ‘race to the bottom’ materialized. Indeed, the evidence shows that even during these lean years of federal intervention several indicators of environmental quality at the state level continued to improve.
abstract_zh: 近年来，将事务下放至地方政府层级，已成为美国某些政治派别中流行的议程之一。虽然人们预期地方政策制定者会调整政策，以符合其选民的偏好，但地方政策的批评者认为，在某些政策由地方控制的情况下，外部性会被忽视，从而产生效率损失。一个典型例子涉及污染控制，已知污染会对邻近辖区产生不利影响。地方政府在获得机会时是否真的会“竞相降低标准”（race to the bottom），并制定宽松的环境政策，目前仍是一个未决问题。在本研究中，我们利用随机占优检验，考察里根总统在20世纪80年代初推行的“新联邦主义”政策是否促使各州降低环境标准。在所分析的多项环境指标中，我们没有发现“竞相降低标准”现象出现的任何证据。事实上，证据显示，即使在联邦干预较少的这段时期，州一级的若干环境质量指标仍在持续改善。

title: Are CO2 Emission Levels Converging Among Industrial Countries?
abstract: Time paths of carbon dioxide emissions in twenty-one industrial countries are examined from 1960-1997 to test for stochastic and conditional convergence. Both panel unit root tests and cross-section regressions are performed. Overall, we find significant evidence that CO2 emissions have converged.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了1960至1997年间21个工业化国家二氧化碳排放的时间路径，以检验随机收敛与条件收敛。我们同时进行了面板单位根检验和截面回归。总体而言，我们发现了显著证据表明二氧化碳排放已经趋同。

venue: Review of Economics and Statistics, (2003), 85(4), pp. 944-952
abstract: This study examines the effects of air quality regulation on economic activity. Anecdotal evidence and some recent empirical studies suggest that an inverse relationship exists between the stringency of environmental regulations and new plant formations. Using a unique county-level data set for New York State from 1980 to 1990, we revisit this conjecture using a seminonparametric method based on propensity score matching. Our empirical estimates suggest that pollution-intensive plants are responding to environmental regulations; more importantly, we find that traditional parametric methods used in previous studies may dramatically understate the impact of more stringent regulations.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了空气质量监管对经济活动的影响。轶事证据以及一些近期的实证研究表明，环境监管的严格程度与新工厂的设立之间存在反向关系。利用纽约州1980至1990年独特的县级数据集，我们采用基于倾向得分匹配的半非参数方法，重新检验了这一推测。我们的实证估计表明，高污染工厂确实会对环境监管作出反应；更重要的是，我们发现以往研究中使用的传统参数方法，可能会严重低估更严格监管的影响。

title: Effects of air quality regulation on the destination choice of relocating plants
abstract: Whether lax environmental regulations are an important attraction for mobile capital remains one of the most controversial issues in the area of regulatory federalism. While the extant literature does a nice job of estimating the effects of environmental regulation on the spatial allocation of new plant births, one neglected area of research is the effect that environmental regulation has on plant relocation decisions. This paper uses an annual (1980–90) county level panel data set to examine the relationship between air quality regulatory stringency and the destination choice of relocating plants. We estimate empirical models using both parametric and semi‐nonparametric specifications. Empirical results from both models suggest that air quality regulations alter significantly the destination choices of relocating plants.
abstract_zh: 宽松的环境监管是否是吸引流动资本的重要因素，仍是监管联邦主义领域中最具争议的问题之一。尽管现有文献在估计环境监管对新工厂空间布局的影响方面已做得很好，但一个被忽视的研究领域是环境监管对工厂迁址决策的影响。本文利用1980至1990年的年度县级面板数据集，考察空气质量监管的严格程度与迁址工厂目的地选择之间的关系。我们分别使用参数化和半非参数化的设定来估计实证模型。两种模型的结果均表明，空气质量监管会显著改变迁址工厂的目的地选择。

title: False Alarm over Environmental False Alarms
The Environmental Kuznets Curve: Real Progress or Misspecified Models?
venue: Review of Economics and Statistics, (2003), 85(4), pp. 1038-1047
abstract: We explore the importance of modeling strategies when estimating the emissions-income relationship. Using U.S. state-level panel data on nitrogen oxide and sulfur dioxide emissions, we estimate several environmental Kuznets curves using the standard parametric framework as well as a more flexible semiparametric alternative. Formal statistical comparisons of the results overwhelmingly reject the parametric approach. Moreover, the differences, particularly for sulfur dioxide, are economically significant.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在估计排放与收入关系时，建模策略的重要性。利用美国各州氮氧化物和二氧化硫排放的州级面板数据，我们既采用标准的参数化框架，又采用更为灵活的半参数替代方法，估计了若干环境库兹涅茨曲线。对结果进行的正式统计比较，绝大多数情况下都拒绝了参数化方法。此外，这些差异（尤其是对于二氧化硫而言）在经济上具有显著意义。

venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, (2003), 46(3), pp. 490-512
abstract: This study explores the linkages between trade policy, corruption, and environmental policy. We begin by presenting a theoretical model that produces several testable predictions: i) trade liberalization raises the stringency of environmental policy; ii) corruption reduces environmental policy stringency; and iii) the effect of trade liberalization (corruption) on environmental policy is conditional on the level of corruption (trade openness). Using panel data from a mix of 30 developed and developing countries from 1982-1992, these predictions are broadly supported.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了贸易政策、腐败与环境政策之间的联系。我们首先提出一个理论模型，该模型给出若干可检验的预测：i) 贸易自由化会提高环境政策的严格程度；ii) 腐败会降低环境政策的严格程度；iii) 贸易自由化（腐败）对环境政策的影响，取决于腐败程度（贸易开放度）的高低。利用1982至1992年间30个发达国家与发展中国家混合样本的面板数据，这些预测总体上得到了支持。

title: Environmental Regulations and New Plant Location Decisions: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis
abstract: Stricter environmental regulations are often opposed on the grounds that they will alter equilibrium capital flows. Empirical evidence in this area remains largely unresolved, mainly due to the quite disparate results found in the literature. This paper takes a positive look at the relationship between new manufacturing plant location decisions and environmental regulations by examining data from 11 studies that provide more than 365 observations. One major result from our meta-analysis is that methodological considerations play a critical role in shaping the body of received estimates. Our empirical estimates also lend insights into future research that is necessary before any robust conclusions can be made regarding the effects of environmental regulations on capital flows.
abstract_zh: 更严格的环境监管常因其可能改变均衡资本流动而遭到反对。该领域的实证证据在很大程度上仍无定论，主要原因在于文献中结果差异很大。本文从实证角度考察新建制造业工厂的选址决策与环境监管之间的关系，所用数据来自11项研究，共提供了365个以上的观测值。我们元分析的一项主要结论是，方法论的考量在塑造现有估计结果方面起着关键作用。我们的实证估计也为未来研究提供了启示：在能够就环境监管对资本流动的影响得出稳健结论之前，仍需开展这些研究。

venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, (2001), 42(3), pp. 277-296
abstract: This paper uses a dynamic model with asymmetric players to explore the question: in a second-best world, should environmental regulations for transboundary pollutants be carried out locally or centrally? We find that combined payoffs are larger with decentralized control if payoffs are sufficiently heterogeneous and initial pollution stocks are sufficiently small. This result obtains because the central authority applies one shadow price to pollution (i.e., it uses uniform standards), whereas local authorities use different shadow prices, and therefore different standards.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个具有非对称参与者的动态模型，探讨如下问题：在次优世界中，跨界污染物的环境监管应当由地方实施还是由中央实施？我们发现，若各方收益的异质性足够大，且初始污染存量足够小，则分权控制下的总收益更大。出现这一结果的原因在于，中央政府对污染施加单一的影子价格（即采用统一标准），而地方政府则采用不同的影子价格，从而设定不同的标准。

abstract: In this article, we use annual (1980–90) county-level manufacturing plant location data for New York State to examine the effects of the 1977 Clean Air Act Amendments on the location decisions of new pollution-intensive manufacturing plants in the “neo-regulatory” (1980–84) and “mature-regulatory” (1985–90) phases of the Act's implementation. Our results suggest that the temporal effects of regulation vary. Whereas the location decisions of pollution intensive manufacturing firms were unaffected by the Act's regulatory restrictions in the “neo-regulatory” period, the restrictions appear to have had a significant negative impact on the location decisions of these types of firms in the Act's “mature-regulatory” phase. The diversion of new pollution intensive plants to counties with less stringent environmental regulations suggests that current US environmental regulations may be leading to a “browning process” whereby counties historically free of pollution become havens for polluters.
abstract_zh: 本文利用纽约州1980至1990年的年度县级制造业工厂选址数据，考察1977年《清洁空气法》修正案在该法实施的“新监管”（1980–84年）与“成熟监管”（1985–90年）两个阶段中，对新建高污染制造业工厂选址决策的影响。我们的结果表明，监管的时间效应存在差异。在“新监管”时期，高污染制造企业的选址决策并未受到该法监管限制的影响；而在该法的“成熟监管”阶段，这些限制似乎对此类企业的选址决策产生了显著的负面影响。新建高污染工厂转向环境监管较宽松的县，表明当前美国的环境监管可能正在引发一种“棕化进程”（browning process），即历史上没有污染的县逐渐成为污染者的避风港。

title: Ranking State Environmental Outputs: Evidence from Panel Data
abstract: This paper uses state‐level pollution data from 1986–1997 to construct two indices that rank U.S. states according to environmental outputs. A major finding is that marginal performers in other indices, such as Wyoming, garner top spots in these ranking systems. The paper also presents findings from fixed and random effects models of panel data that imply state income levels are positively associated with environmental outputs after a threshold level of income is obtained.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1986至1997年的州级污染数据，构建了两个依据环境产出对美国各州进行排名的指数。一项主要发现是，在其他指数中表现平平的州（如怀俄明州）在这些排名体系中却名列前茅。本文还给出了面板数据固定效应与随机效应模型的结果，表明在收入达到某一门槛水平之后，各州收入水平与环境产出呈正相关。

title: Regulatory Federalism and Environmental Protection in the United States
abstract: In this paper we address two aspects of regulatory federalism in U.S. environmental policy. First, we suggest that environmental quality in U.S. states responds positively to increases in income. Second, we provide evidence that environmental quality did not decline when President Reagan's policy of new federalism returned responsibility for many environmental regulations to the states. Thus, state environmental quality appears to reflect more than just the dictates of federal policy. Additionally, we find that a “race to the bottom” in environmental quality did not materialize in the 1980s.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国环境政策中监管联邦主义的两个方面。首先，我们认为美国各州的环境质量会随收入增长而正向提升。其次，我们提供证据表明，当里根总统的“新联邦主义”政策将许多环境监管职责交还给各州时，环境质量并未下降。因此，各州的环境质量似乎反映的不仅仅是联邦政策的要求。此外，我们发现20世纪80年代并未出现环境质量方面的“竞相降低标准”现象。

title: The Effects of Environmental Regulations on Foreign Direct Investment
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, (2000), 40(1), pp. 1-20
abstract: This paper employs a conditional logit model to estimate the effects of state environmental regulations on foreign multinational corporations' new plant location decisions from 1986 to 1993. The relationship between site choice and state environmental regulations is explored, using four measures of regulatory stringency. We find evidence that heterogeneous environmental policies across states do matter.

title: Have Air Pollutant Emissions Converged Amongst U.S. Regions? Evidence from Unit Root Tests
abstract: Previous studies of income distribution have found evidence indicating that incomes across U.S. regions have converged, supporting the prediction of the neoclassical growth model. A potential shortcoming in these studies is that only one measure of well‐being is considered—a measure of wealth linked to incomes or production. This paper examines whether income convergence was accompanied by air pollutant emission convergence. Results from unit root tests provide some evidence that indicators of environmental quality have converged across U.S. regions during the 1929‐1994 period.
abstract_zh: 以往关于收入分配的研究发现，美国各地区的收入已经趋同，这支持了新古典增长模型的预测。这些研究的一个潜在不足在于，它们只考虑了一种福利指标，即与收入或产出相关的财富衡量指标。本文考察了收入趋同是否伴随着空气污染物排放的趋同。单位根检验的结果提供了一些证据，表明在1929至1994年期间，美国各地区的环境质量指标已经趋同。

title: Optimal institutional arrangements for pollution control
venue: Journal of Regional Analysis and Policy, (1998), 26(1), pp. 113-133
abstract: This paper tests the notion that states adopted lax environmental policies after the Reagan administration’s declaration of a new federalism approach to environmental regulation. Empirical findings from a two way fixed effects model indicate states increased, rather than decreased, pollution abatement expenditures after the Reagan devolution in the early 1980s. In addition, the east substantially increased abatement expenditures after the early 1980s, while the midwest and west lagged the national average. A simple dummy variable dispersion test reveals environmental policies exhibit signs of convergence since the federal government passed primary control of the environment to the states.
abstract_zh: 本文检验了如下观点：在里根政府宣布对环境监管采取“新联邦主义”路线之后，各州采取了宽松的环境政策。双向固定效应模型的实证结果表明，在20世纪80年代初里根政府实行权力下放之后，各州的污染治理支出不降反升。此外，东部地区在20世纪80年代初之后大幅增加了治理支出，而中西部和西部地区则落后于全国平均水平。一个简单的虚拟变量离散度检验显示，自联邦政府将环境的主要控制权移交给各州以来，环境政策呈现出趋同的迹象。
